q1.question: Melmi ara d-yas Trokacha?
q1.answer: Trokacha ad d-yas zik ɣef iOS d Android. Jerred ɣer newsletter akken ad k-nlɣu mi ara d-yekker!

q2.question: Amek i yeddu umsenfel di Trokacha?
q2.answer: Ssufeɣ talɣut-ik, wali tid n wiyaḍ. Akken ad tessumeṛ amsenfel: fren 1 neɣ 2 n telɣutin-ik sdaw, swipe ɣer uyeffus. I yidrimen, swipe ɣer uzelmaḍ. Ma yeqbel wayeḍ, d match, tzemreḍ ad tmeslayeḍ!

q3.question: Assiweḍ n yikarduten s laman?
q3.answer: Ih! Yal asiwweḍ yettwasenqed terna tamezdagnut tesmizwir-it. Tzemreḍ ad tḍefṛeḍ akardun-ik srid terna ad tmeslayeḍ d usiwweḍ.

q4.question: Trokacha d baṭel?
q4.answer: Ih, Trokacha d baṭel maṛṛa! Ulac isurfen uffiren, ulac aɣrum. Asnagraw-nneɣ adimanṣi yebna ɣef tmahilin premium d afran.

q5.question: Anida yella Trokacha?
q5.answer: Trokacha ad yili di yal tawilaylin n Lezzayer seg tazwara. Iswi-nneɣ d aqqen n Yizzayriyen seg Tamanrasset ɣer Ɛennaba!

q6.question: Amek ara iliɣ d asiwweḍ di Trokacha?
q6.answer: Rnu kan amiḍan-ik terna rmed afran n usiwweḍ. Ad tizmireḍ ad twaliḍ tussniwin n ussiweḍ ɣef yiberdan-ik terna ad tessumeṛ imeẓla-k.

cta.title: Ili gar yimezwura!
cta.subtitle: Asnas ad d-yas zik. Jerred akken ad k-nlɣu mi ara d-yekker terna ad tesɛuḍ ayen yemgaraden.
cta.note: Imezwura yejjerden ad sɛun tmahilin tiyizdigen

privacy.title: Tasertit n tbaḍnit
privacy.intro: S lḥukum n usaḍuf 18-07 n 10 yunyu 2018 ɣef ummesten n yimdanen deg usesfer n yisefka udmawanen, yettubeddlen s usaḍuf 11-25 n yulyu 2025, Trokacha yezdeɣ ad yeḥrez isefka udmawanen n yiseqdacen-is.

a1.title: Amagrad 1 - Amsebded n usesfer
a1.content: Trokacha - Aseddu n uselɣu srid - Lezzayer

a2.title: Amagrad 2 - Isefka yettwalqḍen
a2.intro: Trokacha yelqeḍ kan isefka ilaqen i umahel n umeẓlu:
items: Isefka n usuɣel (isem, talalit)
Tansiwin (imayl, uṭṭun n tilifun)
I yisufar: unɣel n turagt n usfar
Isefka n tunigin d useqdec n useddu
Isefka n temhelt (amazray n telɣutin, imsenfal, isiziwen)

a3.title: Amagrad 3 - Tasila tusḍift n usesfer
items: Amtawa s tifin d usfehm n useqdac
Aselkem n umsaḍuf n umeẓlu
Tiḥuqranin tusḍifin n Trokacha
Iswi ilmawen (asewḥel n lkira, asnerni n umeẓlu)

a4.title: Amagrad 4 - Izerfan-ik
a4.intro: S lḥukum n usaḍuf 18-07, tesɛiḍ izerfan-agi:
items: Azref n unekcum ɣer yisefka-k udmawanen
Azref n useɣti n yisefka ur nellin ara d imeɣta
Azref n tukksa n yisefka (azref n uttun)
Azref n umgal n usesfer
Azref n usettef n usesfer
Azref n usenkez n yisefka
Azref n ukkes n umtawa-k melmi tebɣiḍ
a4.contact: Izerfan-agi zemren ad ttwaselkmen s unermes ɣer

a5.title: Amagrad 5 - Aḥraz n yisefka
items: Di yal akud n useqdec urmid n umiḍan
3 n yiseggasen deffir tamahilt taneggarut n umiḍan
Dɣa ttwaẓnen s lḥukum n tiḥuqranin tusḍifin
Ttwakksen meṛṛa deffir tegnit-agi

a6.title: Amagrad 6 - Taɣellist n yisefka
a6.intro: Trokacha yesseqdac tiɣaṛiwin tekinikanin d tuddsinanin:
items: Anegzum n yisefka iḥulfen
Asenqed aḥebbus n unekcum
Tiftisin n tɣellist iwatayen
Asileɣ n yinaxdamen

a7.title: Amagrad 7 - Alɣu n trewla
a7.content: Ma tella trewla n yisefka yezmer ad d-yawi ugur meqqren i yizerfan-ik, Trokacha ad ylɣu ANPDP deg 5 n wussan (s lḥukum n usaḍuf 11-25) d yiseqdacen yettwaɛnan deg wakud afessas.

a8.title: Amagrad 8 - Asenkez n yisefka
a8.content: Isefka udmawanen llan di Lezzayer. Yal asenkez ɣer tmurt-nniḍen yesra turagt n ANPDP d tḥuqranin iwatayen.

a9.title: Amagrad 9 - Azref n tẓiḍḍert
a9.content: Tzemreḍ ad teǧǧeḍ taẓiḍḍert ɣer ANPDP (Tamazɣa Taɣelnawt n Ummesten n Yisefka Udmawanen) ma tḥeqqeḍ izerfan-ik ur ttwaqadren ara.

echange.title: Amsenfel, Tizwert & Tiɣin
echange.subtitle: Wali amek ara tsenfleḍ, tzenzeḍ neɣ taɣeḍ s sshula ɣef Trokacha
echange.stepsSubtitle: Seg usuffeɣ ɣer usmizzwer, ḍfeṛ yal amecwaṛ n umsenfel-ik

step1.title: Ssufeɣ talɣut-ik
step1.description: Ṭṭef tiswirin n tɣara, rnu aglam leqqayen terna sbadu ssuma neɣ ayen tettnadi di lmendad.
step1.tip: Tiswirin ifeclen d uglam ummid ssnernayent tignatin-ik n tifin n umsenfel!

step2.title: Wali talɣutin
step2.description: Ẓer tuẓẓimt n yiseqdacen-nniḍen. Smizwer s taggayt, adig neɣ anaw n umsenfel tebɣiḍ.
step2.tip: Seqdec imsizdigen akken ad d-tafeḍ s zik ayen tettnadi.

step3.title: Eg asumer
step3.description: Talɣut k-teɛjeb? Fren 1 neɣ 2 n telɣutin-ik sdaw, swipe ɣer uyeffus i umsenfel, neɣ ɣer uzelmaḍ i tuzna s yidrimen.
step3.tip: Swipe ayeffus = amsenfel, swipe azelmaḍ = idrimen. D fessus!

step4.title: D Match!
step4.description: Ma yeqbel useqdac-nniḍen asumer-ik, d match! Tzemreḍ tura ad tmeslayeḍ ɣef yigmaḍ.
step4.tip: Match yeɛna sin yeẓran ḥṛicen - amṣekkar yezmer ad yekker.

step5.title: Sentem aseḍmu
step5.description: Ticki igmaḍ llan, sentem aseḍmu-k. Ticki tettwaddeḍmeḍ, iɣunas-ik seggmen ur zmiren ara ad ttwasumren i wiyaḍ.
step5.tip: Aseḍmu yessekker iɣunas-ik i umsenfel-agi kan. Ayagi iḍemmen azga n temhelt.

step6.title: Senfel
step6.description: Mlil akken ad tsenfleḍ tiqeccaḍ neɣ ad tfakeḍ tizwert akken twafqem.
step6.tip: Fren adig azayez d uɣellsan i yimsenfal-ik.

step7.title: Smizwer terna fak
step7.description: Deffir umsenfel, smizwer tarmit-ik. Isiziwen-ik ɛawnen tamezdagnut ad teɛqel iseqdacen n taflest.
step7.tip: Asmizzwer yelhan ik-iɛawen ad tebniḍ taɣult-ik ɣef useddu!
